TPU.name: Google TPU
TPU.summary: Google's in-house accelerator. Broadcom designs and supplies most of it; MediaTek is reported to co-design part of the v8 and v9 families. Sold through Google Cloud to Anthropic, Meta and others, and from 2027 through a Blackstone-backed TPU cloud.

generations.name: TPU v7 Ironwood
generations.note: Current volume part. SemiAnalysis cut its 2026 Ironwood estimate from 3.2M to 2.7M units, mainly because CoWoS-S packaging capacity is ramping slowly

generations.name: TPU 8t (training)
generations.note: 9,600-chip superpods, 216 GB HBM per chip; 2.7× Ironwood's training price-performance. Broadcom reported as designer ('Sunfish')

generations.name: TPU 8i (inference)
generations.note: Pods of up to 1,152 chips, 288 GB HBM per chip. Broadcom guides 5 GW of 8i for Anthropic in 2027

generations.name: TPU v8e
generations.note: Reported MediaTek design ('Humufish') with a Marvell custom networking chip on Intel 18A

generations.name: TPU v9 'Triggerfish'
generations.note: Reported MediaTek design with an on-package CPU tile; volume ramp 2028

generations.name: TPU v10
generations.note: Market chatter that AMD is involved (packaging and CPU IP)

users.note: Internal workloads; Broadcom expects Google to buy 'multi-tens of billions' of TPUs a year
Up to 1M TPUs (Oct 2025); 5 GW of new Google Cloud capacity over five years; Broadcom guides +5 GW of 8i in 2027 and +10 GW in 2028
Blackstone-majority venture, ~$25B including debt; first 500 MW in 2027; no anchor customer named

volume.note: DIGITIMES Research forecasts 3.325M Google TPUs shipped in 2026
Broadcom's 2026 CoWoS wafer allocation estimate cut from 250k to 215k (SemiAnalysis)

Trainium.name: AWS Trainium
Trainium.summary: Amazon's training and inference accelerator from its Annapurna Labs unit. Marvell helped design earlier generations; Alchip is reported to co-develop Trainium3 and 4. Anthropic and OpenAI are anchor users.

generations.name: Trainium2
generations.note: Fastest demand ramp of any Amazon chip; Amazon's custom chip business runs above $10B a year

generations.name: Trainium3
generations.note: Mass production early 2026; Amazon expects supply fully committed by mid-2026

generations.name: Trainium4
generations.note: Strong customer interest per Amazon; Alchip reported as design partner

users.note: Primary training partner (Project Rainier); up to ~5 GW over time
2 GW of Trainium capacity added with Amazon's Feb 2026 investment

MTIA.name: Meta MTIA
MTIA.summary: Meta's in-house accelerator for ranking and recommendation, moving into generative AI. Broadcom designs MTIA; GUC is reported to handle back-end work on MTIA-3.

generations.name: MTIA (Broadcom)
generations.note: Broadcom expects production shipments of Meta's custom accelerator to begin in its fiscal Q4

generations.name: MTIA-3
generations.note: GUC reported to handle back-end design and packaging

users.note: Internal use; Meta also rents Google TPUs and buys NVIDIA and AMD GPUs

Maia.name: Microsoft Maia
Maia.summary: Microsoft's in-house accelerator for Azure. Marvell is reported as a design partner.

users.note: Internal use alongside NVIDIA and AMD GPUs

OpenAI-XPU.name: OpenAI custom accelerator
OpenAI-XPU.summary: OpenAI's own accelerator, designed with Broadcom: 10 GW from the second half of 2026.

users.note: Alongside NVIDIA (10 GW LOI) and AMD (6 GW) GPUs

GPU.name: Merchant GPUs (NVIDIA, AMD)
GPU.summary: The general-purpose path: NVIDIA's GPUs and systems, with AMD as the second source. Sold to every cloud, neocloud and model lab.

exposure.est: Likely half or more of AI revenue
exposure.basis: Custom XPUs were 73% of Broadcom's Q3 FY26 AI revenue; Google is its largest XPU customer and Anthropic's capacity is TPUs. The TPU share is our estimate
Production shipments of Meta's accelerator from fiscal Q4 2026
Counterpoint: ~400k AI ASIC units in 2026 rising to ~5M (26% share) by 2028, all for Google so far
Designed earlier Trainium generations and has a five-year supply agreement with AWS; share of new Trainium designs may fall as Alchip takes on Trainium3/4
Reported TPU v8e networking chip win

Optical circuit switches for TPU pods; its largest customer was 26.6% of FY2026 revenue (anonymised, widely reported as Google)
Designs the TPU and sells capacity through Google Cloud
